config.configfile.description: Path to the main Cyrus IMAP configuration file (imapd.conf)

config.servername.description: Hostname used in server banners and logs for identification

config.sasl_pwcheck_path.description: Path or method used to check SASL passwords (e.g., saslauthd, auxprop)

config.auxprop_plugin.description: SASL auxiliary property plugin for password lookup (e.g., sasldb, ldapdb)

config.services.lmtpunix.enabled.description: Enable the local LMTP socket for mail delivery and admin tools

config.services.lmtpunix_zm.enabled.description: Enable LMTP socket for ZMailer-style delivery (rare; leave disabled unless needed)

config.services.pop3.enabled.description: Enable plain POP3 service (port 110) — discouraged for security

config.services.pop3s.enabled.description: Enable POP3 over TLS (port 995) — discouraged, prefer IMAPS

config.services.sieve.enabled.description: Enable Sieve script management for mail filtering (port 4190)

config.services.saslauthd.enabled.description: Enable SASL authentication daemon socket (required for login)

config.services.ctl_mboxlist.enabled.description: Enable mailbox list control service (required for cyradm, cyradmin)

config.services.ctl_deliver.enabled.description: Enable mail delivery control service (for 'ctl_deliver' commands)

config.services.ctl_cyrusdb.enabled.description: Enable Cyrus database control service (for DB recovery/management)

config.services.submit.enabled.description: Enable submit socket for MTA integration (e.g., sendmail 'submit' mode)

config.loglevel.description: Syslog logging verbosity: debug, info, notice, warning, err

config.lock_path.description: Directory for mailbox and database lock files

config.work_path.description: Directory for spooling temporary and working files

config.ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format)

config.ssl_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format)

config.ssl_ca_file.description: Optional path to CA certificate bundle for client verification

config.ssl_cipher_list.description: List of allowed TLS ciphersuites (colon or comma separated)

config.mboxlist_db.description: Database backend for mailbox list (e.g., berkeley, sqlite)

config.unique_name_db.description: Database backend for unique name mapping

config.timelimit.description: Maximum seconds a client session may remain idle before disconnect

config.idletimelimit.description: Seconds before IDLE command auto-logout (0 = unlimited)

config.defaultdomain.description: Default domain suffix to append to short usernames during auth

config.quota_default.description: Default per-mailbox quota in bytes (e.g., 52428800 = 50 MiB)

config.quota_warning.description: Percentage of quota at which warning messages are issued (0–100)

config.admin_sasl_name.description: SASL username required to use cyradm or administrative commands

config.allowplaintext.description: Allow plaintext authentication over non-TLS connections (security risk)
